prompt.text:
Pixel-art sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: the campaign zone-map planet of zone D (MAGMA DEEP): a single round planet disc viewed straight on (a perfect circle, no rings, no moons, no tilt ellipse). The sphere is shaded in four crisp posterised bands brightening toward a highlight at the top-left, with a thin dark rim-light along the lower-right edge and a clean 1-px near-black outline all around. The disc is fully opaque with hard pixel edges. Nothing else: no starfield, no glow cloud, no text, no letter drawn on or near the planet..

Design identity to keep exactly — a scorched basalt world, very dark (#1a1212 shadow, #2a1408, #3a221a, #5a3a28 toward light): radial glowing lava cracks splitting the dark rock — deep red (#a02c10) at the crack edges, orange (#d0501c) in the cores and small yellow-hot (#f8b048) glow pools — with grey ash fields (#4a3632) and a faint warm rim light (#f8c860). a single round planet disc viewed straight on (a perfect circle, no rings, no moons, no tilt ellipse). The sphere is shaded in four crisp posterised bands brightening toward a highlight at the top-left, with a thin dark rim-light along the lower-right edge and a clean 1-px near-black outline all around. The disc is fully opaque with hard pixel edges. Nothing else: no starfield, no glow cloud, no text, no letter drawn on or near the planet.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- The sheet holds exactly ONE cell — the WHOLE canvas is the single subject's frame; an empty sheet ruins it.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom):
  cell 1 = the MAGMA DEEP zone planet The subject fills the cell as ONE large centred figure, aspect ratio about 1.0:1 (0.8:1 to 1.25:1).
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 512×512 px. Produce EXACTLY 1 subject cell — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 12 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells: no subject may touch or cross a cell edge; keep every subject within the inner 75% of its cell.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: the finest retro pixel art for its native resolution — crisp hard-edged square pixels, chunky bold forms, a rich four-to-six step shading ramp lit from the top-left with careful inner detail and real material texture, clean saturated colours, a 1-px near-black outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients.
prompt.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, letters, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, signature, blurry, anti-aliasing, smooth gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, drop shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell, cropped subject, subject touching edge

notes: w15-REING7 (gen7 row a-planet-d): the MAGMA DEEP planet for the zone map's corner, the 512x512 key-green cell's subject bbox widened 6 px, contain-fit into the 27x27 slot. FLUX.2-dev non-commercial ruling 2026-10-23.
